releaseNotes: Keeps the hardware-confirmed Notes editor, mixed colors, resize, autosave and fullscreen behavior unchanged
Removes the redundant rounded tool-summary pill such as Füllfeder · 8px or Marker · 22px from the normal Notes toolbar
Pen and marker type/width remain visible and adjustable in the contextual options below, so no functionality is lost
The compact fullscreen top-right tool indicator and X exit control remain unchanged
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
